archive.catalogue_description: Project Viking V1.1 Update. I have decided to update my map which was released roughly 2 years ago, Project Viking! This update will feature some bug fixes, and modifications to the map overall. One of the main additions to this map is a full easter egg for classic mode. Many people have been constantly requesting that I add a easter egg which can be completed to earn victory on classic mode. Previously, the only way to “beat” the map was to play a specific gamemode and detonate a moab without going down. Now, players can earn victory by completing a series of steps in the map. I won’t reveal all these steps instantly, however I will say that most of the sidequests (such as filling up chests, collecting afterlife skulls, riding crane, boy of silence), are now all apart of the main easter egg. Since I wanted to add some final features into my map, that ment I had to sacrafice some of the older features not much people liked or used. Aside from the easter egg, a series of other things have been updated. Heres a small list of some of the changes: Removed beta message Removed ability to hold out bowie knife Removed deadshot Fixed beta G_SPAWN error. (Implemented debug system to track ents) Fixed logic for vulture and widows drops (only player who has perk can see and colled drops) Fixed series of bugs which occured in beta version Added gravity spikes/Ragnarok dg4, obtained in a step of ee. Allowed players to release themself from panzer after fully retracted Allowed panzer to sp

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc, maps/_utility.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). The scanner found easter-egg state; WHICH combination means done is a human's call, so the finish is {"manual": true} and the Round 20 fallback applies meanwhile.  DEDI 2026-09-22 (run map05, after the mount fix): the map now LOADS and spawns a server (`------ Server Initialization ------ / Server: nazi_zombie_test`), then dies with a GSC runtime error and the server shuts down. `undefined is not an array, string, or vector` at `common_scripts/utility.gsc:463 while( !level.flag[ msg ] )`, from `maps/_zombiemode_ai_mech.gsc:38 flag_wait("all_players_connected")`, threaded at the map's own `maps/_zombiemode.gsc:40`, from `nazi_zombie_test.gsc:119`. `level.flag` is created by `maps/_load.gsc:97`'s `flag_init("all_players_connected")`, so a map-provided script is flag_waiting before `_load::main()` has run. NOT ours: we mount no overlay (fs_game is the map's own mod, the referee is C++ and ships nothing inside it), the console shows `Loading fastfile 'mod'` and the map fastfile loading, and Der Berg answers getstatus with the same mount. Why the same script survives on a listen server is NOT established. dedi.md 13.3, referee.md 10. RETRACTION: the earlier note blamed `fs_game is write protected` and a homepath config.cfg. Both wrong -- see nazi_zombie_test1's note and dedi.md 13.3. The map now loads. DEDI/REFEREE 2026-09-22 (runs mapA/mapB/mapC, join80-join83): THE 'broken' VERDICT IS CONFIRMED AND THE BLAME IS CORRECTED. The previous session left open whether our dedicated server, a referee GSC overlay or the replay sampler was the shared cause. It is none of them, and that was settled by running the maps with ours REMOVED rather than by reading code. dedi.md 14, referee.md 11. Run mapA booted this map on a STOCK CoDWaW.exe -- binkw32 proxy reverted, ZERO ENW code in the process -- as a LISTEN server, and it produced the byte-identical script runtime error. The cause is the map's own script order: main() starts a flag-dependent thread BEFORE it calls maps\_zombiemode::main(), which is what calls maps\_load::main(), which is where flag_init("all_players_connected") lives. A GSC `thread` begins executing immediately and flag_wait's first act is to index level.flag, so it faults before anything can have created the array. WHY THE COMMUNITY PLAYS IT ANYWAY IS NOT ESTABLISHED, and is written down as unestablished; the likeliest answer is that the archived download is a repack. Nothing in this lane can fix it. status stays "broken". From nazi_zombie_test.iwd: its own maps/_zombiemode.gsc line 40 threads maps\_zombiemode_ai_mech::mech_init(), whose line 38 is flag_wait("all_players_connected"); its own maps/_load.gsc carries the flag_init at line 99 and is not reached by line 40.  ARCHIVE 2026-09-23: NO ADD-ON EXISTS TO BLAME. The release is six files and matches the NSIS installer's file table exactly; there is no third-party iwd in the mod folder at all. The fatal maps/_zombiemode_ai_mech.gsc is inside the map's OWN nazi_zombie_test.iwd, which also carries the author's own maps/_load.gsc and maps/_utility.gsc overrides -- 73 raw scripts, the author's source tree. There is nothing to exclude. Re-measured as shipped in run addon7: the same script runtime error. status stays "broken". dedi.md 15.
